newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLAR SAYS CERVUCTUM BUYS MORE WARRANTS.
newsitem.headline: POLAR SAYS CERVUCTUM BUYS MORE WARRANTS.

text.p: Finnish construction group Polar-yhtyma Oy said on Wednesday that Cervuctum Oy had bought more convertible bonds and warrants in it and that Cervuctum wanted to improve Polar's capital structure.

Cervuctum -- an investment company owner by Metra, UPM-Kymmene and Partek and SOK -- in August acquired Polar warrants and convertible bonds which would give it a 32.7 percent stake in the company if converted.
Cervuctum then had warrants with for a nominal value of 353.5 million markka and convertible bonds with a nominal value of 91.1 million markka.
"Cervuctum now has bonds with warrants for a nominal value of 436.1 million markka and convertible bonds for a 93.3 million markka nominal value," Polar said.
"In addition, Cervuctum has 25.6 million Polar warrants," it said, but did not give Cervuctum's new potential shareholding.
"Cervuctum Oy has said it is prepared take part in talks aiming to support strengthening Polar's capital structure with the bonds purchased," Polar said.
"Polar-yhtyma Oy's board has decided to investigate prerequisities for further actions," it added.
